description: youtube: Search. GET /v1/youtube/search. Search YouTube videos, channels, playlists, Shorts and live streams. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

continuationToken.description: Use continuationToken from the previous response to get the next page.

duration.description: Duration of the video. Only applies to videos (not shorts).

includeExtras.description: Include like/comment counts and descriptions; slows the response. Use /v1/youtube/video for full details.

query.description: Search query. Use intitle: for stricter title matching, e.g. intitle:"Foursquare Swarm". YouTube may broaden quoted queries when no fresh exact matches exist.

region.description: Two-letter country code for the proxy location.

type.description: Type of content to search for

name: youtube_search
